name: Odeya Blouse (Adire Print)
description:
A loose, flowing blouse cut from a medium-weight fabric printed in a modern interpretation of traditional Yoruba adire resist-dyeing: deep indigo ground with irregular white geometric resists — circles, broken lines, scatter patterns — that look hand-done because they were, at least in the original design that the print is derived from. The silhouette is generous through the body with wide sleeves that taper at the wrist, a V-neckline, and a hem that falls to mid-hip. The fabric moves well and the color holds through washing.

Made by a small family label out of the Tier 2 textile district — Odeya has been producing adire-influenced pieces for three generations, adapting the patterns each decade while maintaining the visual language. The blouse is popular across Tiers 2 through 4, worn by people who appreciate heritage design and by people who simply think it's beautiful without knowing its context. Both are fine.
what_it_says: I carry something forward without making a speech about it.
worn_by: people with West African family heritage
story_hooks: The specific resist pattern on one blouse — an unusual variation — appears in a three-hundred-year-old photograph, raising questions about how the design survived.
Odeya's original pattern archive was stolen; the family is quietly trying to recover it before a corponation files a design patent on their own heritage.
A character receives this blouse as a gift from someone they've never met, with a note that says only: 'She would have wanted you to have it.'

physical_description.visual_profile: A flowing, relaxed blouse with generous proportions that drapes softly on the body. The silhouette reads as effortlessly elegant — neither tight nor shapeless — with an inviting V-neckline and wide sleeves that taper at the wrist. The hem lands at mid-hip, creating a balanced line that works equally well tucked or loose.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the body with room for movement; wide sleeves that narrow gracefully at the cuff; V-neckline creates vertical flow without clinging
physical_description.primary_material: Medium-weight natural-synthetic blend cotton-viscose with slight drape; durable enough for frequent wear and washing
physical_description.texture: Smooth finish with subtle hand-printed texture variation; the resist-dye creates tactile irregularities that catch light differently across the garment's surface
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep indigo ground with white geometric resists: irregular circles, broken lines, scatter patterns that mimic hand-application. The effect is organic and meditative despite being mechanically printed.
physical_description.closures: None — pulls over the head; relaxed V-neckline requires no fasteners
distinctive_features: Adire-inspired resist-print with visible hand-drawn quality to geometric patterns
Wide sleeves that taper at wrist cuff
Subtle weave texture that holds indigo dye evenly
Odeya Textiles label-woven into inner side seam
Mid-hip hem allows for styling flexibility
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 accessible luxury; heritage-informed design at working-class pricing
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by people who value diaspora craftsmanship, cultural lineage, or simply beautiful textiles. Popular in creative sectors, education, and mixed Tier 2–4 social circles. Signals appreciation for slow fashion and non-Western design without gatekeeping.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in softness after a few washes; indigo may lighten slightly at stress points (neckline, sleeve cuffs) but holds its depth in body. The resist patterns may develop subtle craquelure from wear, adding character.

image_prompt: A loose indigo adire blouse with irregular white geometric resist patterns hanging on a dark dress form, photographed in moody studio lighting with cool backlighting. The deep indigo fabric catches light along the draping folds and wide sleeves. Background is a textured dark concrete or warehouse wall, slightly out of focus. Shallow depth of field. Cyberpunk textile aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
